## Background

I am a computational and theoretical physicist who loves to teach. I enjoy working with
students on research projects and bringing contemporary physics research into the classroom.

- Ph.D., Physics and Astronomy, University of Pennsylvania
- M.S., Physics and Astronomy, University of Pennsylvania
- B.A., Physics and Astronomy, DePauw University

## Research

Nanotechnology, quantum chemistry, biological physics, epidemic models, radio
astronomy, gravitational lensing, and quantum computing. My doctoral work
focused on modifying the electronic and optical properties of carbon nanotubes
using electromagnetic fields.

## Contact

Grades, assignments, and office hours for enrolled students are in Canvas. Everyone else can
reach me through the [OIT directory](https://www.oit.edu/directory/jesse-kinder).
